title: place.bookingAvailability
description:
Indicates whether the place still has tickets or reservations available. The `type` can only be `Available` for places (as opposed to events that can also have `Unavailable` when sold out), as a place can never be completely sold out forever.

A `waitingListUrl` is not allowed here: a waiting list is specific to one date of an event, so it can only be set on the [bookingAvailability of an event subEvent](./event-subEvent-bookingAvailability.json).

waitingListUrl.description: Not allowed on the `bookingAvailability` of a place. A waiting list can only be set on the `bookingAvailability` of an event `subEvent`.
